name: 92861 · Villa Park, CA
findings: ZIP 92861 (Villa Park) has 64 nonprofit organizations. 16 of them (25%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 16 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 92861 (Villa Park) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 92861 (Villa Park) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.2 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 12 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
